sections.content: Bring together the pretérito perfecto, ya, todavía no and porque in a short family communication narrative. Describe recent calls, messages and conversations, say what has already happened or has not happened yet, and give simple reasons.

items.spanish: Todavía no he contestado porque estoy ocupado.
items.english: I have not answered yet because I am busy.

items.spanish: He hablado con mi padre porque he recibido una noticia.
items.english: I have spoken with my father because I have received some news.
We have already had a conversation.

sections.content: Use ya for completed recent actions, todavía no for actions that remain unfinished, and porque to explain the reason.
